# Houseki banner

[houseki-banner.jpg](houseki-banner.jpg) is the README banner and social-preview export at 1280 × 640 pixels.
[houseki-banner.png](houseki-banner.png) retains the full 1774 × 887 edited artwork. The JPEG is a proportional export
with no crop or added content. Both files have opaque backgrounds.

The banner uses the tagline **Private by design. Powered by Moon Math.** The former technology label is removed.
It was created and edited with Codex's built-in image generation on 2026-10-18. The original artwork is preserved in
Git commit `884b458`. The edit prompt below uses that artwork as its reference and retains the gemstone composition.

GitHub's [social-preview guidance](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/customizing-your-repositorys-social-media-preview)
recommends 1280 × 640 pixels and a file under 1 MB. The JPEG meets both. To use it for repository links, upload
`houseki-banner.jpg` under the repository's **Settings → Social preview**. Embedding it in the README does not configure
that setting.

## Edit prompt

```text
Edit the supplied Houseki repository banner with two specific typography changes, preserving the artwork and composition.
1. Remove the small lower-left text "RUST / CRYPTOGRAPHY / PROOFS" entirely. Restore the same unobtrusive dark background there. Do not replace it with any other label.
2. Replace the current subtitle "Native foundations for private value." with exactly:
"Private by design. Powered by Moon Math."
Keep this subtitle below the large Houseki title, in the same muted sage color, contemporary sans serif style, with beautiful spacing and comfortable separation from the crystal. The complete new tagline must be clearly readable. If needed, use two balanced lines: "Private by design." and "Powered by Moon Math." Keep it visually subordinate to the main title.
Invariants: Retain the main wordmark "Houseki" exactly and preserve its size, position and ivory typography. Keep the existing green gemstone, its facets and refraction, the background technical construction lines, charcoal palette, lighting and surface reflection unchanged. Keep the wide 2:1 landscape canvas, generous safe margins and opaque background. Add no new objects, borders, symbols, labels or other text.
The only readable text in the result must be "Houseki" and "Private by design. Powered by Moon Math." Preserve the exact punctuation and capitalization.
```
